newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Malaria kills over 200 in Zimbabwe in two months.
newsitem.headline: Malaria kills over 200 in Zimbabwe in two months.

text.p: Malaria has killed 201 people in Zimbabwe in the last two months in an epidemic triggered by heavy rains and flooded rivers, the ministry of health said on Friday.
The ministry also warned that the situation was likely to get worse.
It said in a statement the death figure, out of some 106,721 cases of infection, was higher than last year's 122 deaths recorded out of 91,000 cases.

"Malaria incidences are expected to get worse as the rainfall subsides. The Ministry has therefore put all provinces on alert in case of further epidemics," it said, adding that it had boosted its anti-malaria campaign.
